subject.title: [Performance] Duplicate parsing of CA certificates in node-extra-ca-certs.ts on every connection

question: Should OpenClaw treat the extra-CA bundle as process-stable and require a restart for certificate-file changes, allowing the parsed certificates to be cached once?
rationale: Caching is straightforward only after maintainers confirm that any effective live certificate reload behavior is accidental rather than a supported operational contract.

options.title: Use restart semantics
options.body: Cache the parsed bundle during startup and document that certificate-file changes require restarting OpenClaw, matching Node's environment-variable lifecycle.

options.title: Preserve runtime refresh
options.body: Retain explicit file-change detection or reload behavior and optimize repeated parsing without making the bundle process-stable.

recommendation.title: Use restart semantics
recommendation.body: Cache the parsed bundle during startup and document that certificate-file changes require restarting OpenClaw, matching Node's environment-variable lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work is the clearest available provenance for OpenClaw's NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS startup lifecycle.
